promptText: LOCAL LOWER-BODY EDIT of image1 only: exact same alchemy boy, original full-canvas framing. Freeze the head/hair/face/neck, torso ABOVE BELT, both arms/hands and held props, bag/scrolls/ribbons/robe silhouette at original size and positions. Do not enlarge/recenter or move the full character. Camera is SOUTHWEST toward screen lower-left, three-quarter front camera. BOTH boot long axes stay aligned SOUTHWEST, ivory toe toward screen lower-left and heel behind/upper-right. Front-to-back support progression goes from lower-left through below pelvis toward upper-right, NOT an outward hip/knee swing. Keep the advancing leg in this single stride plane and avoid the previous07-to08 sideways jump. Image2 is this same boy's correct supporting-foot mechanics reference ONLY: use its planted ankle/sole and weight-bearing relationship, not its head pose or entire figure. Image3 is approved painting/material style only, no UI. This frame has anatomical LEFT as the ONLY grounded WEIGHT-BEARING SUPPORT foot; anatomical RIGHT is the raised recovering/swing foot. SECOND drawing of SLIGHTLY-BEHIND-BODY SUPPORT pair. Same support foot is a little FARTHER behind pelvis than previous pose, still carrying weight. Heel begins lifting while broad forefoot remains pressed down on the ground; show a natural knee/ankle extension, not a straight locked stick. Opposite knee rises a little farther forward and foot remains lifted. Both feet must NOT be airborne. Redraw both legs below the belt as necessary for correct connections, retaining exact original ivory baggy pants, jade-gold floral boots, and proportions. Keep every support contact readable from a flattened contacting sole/forefoot, natural knee flex, and hip-to-ankle load path. Moving foot back is a new drawn anatomical pose, never a cutout translation or warp. No added floor/shadow/ground marks are needed. At every frame at least one foot is clearly grounded. Keep the support toe at the correct projected ground plane matching reference2 and scene perspective; do not raise it to fake stance or plant a hovering shoe. Preserve the original target head/body scale and safe canvas margins; front planted soles near original ground level, rear ground contact follows modest perspective depth. Original RIGHT hand bronze cauldron and LEFT hand green bottle remain exactly unchanged, no new accessories, no mirror, no swapped limbs. Deliver ONE native1254x1254 RGBA transparent sprite with original1024 framing proportionally preserved, clean alpha, no background/text, original bright orange/jade/ivory/gold detailed Chinese chibi painting. The LEFT supporting foot is the REAR boot, screen-right behind the pelvis. It must extend down-back to meet the ground, NOT tuck up under the body. Its toe/forefoot reaches near native canvas y1100, with heel raised behind it toward upper-right. The RIGHT swinging knee and shoe are in FRONT, screen-left/lower-left; this FRONT boot must stay lifted and must NOT become the support. Preserve the distinct raised front leg versus stretched rear planted leg. The rear planted boot toe points lower-left, not downward-only and not to the right. Keep the head exactly registered to image1.
